facts.fact: Africa Data Centres' own release states CPT1 has a Water Usage Effectiveness of 0 because the IT infrastructure consumes no water; the date is the release's publication date, as it gives none for the statement.
The release states CPT1 uses wheeled solar power under a 20-year power purchase agreement signed in March 2023 with Distributed Power Africa, part of the Cassava Technologies group.

note: No PUE figure is given, only an 'impressive' rating, so no pue fact.
